schools.name: Princeton University

schools.waiver_process_en: The page says applicants meeting the criteria need not submit scores, but does not say whether any request is needed.

schools.name: Massachusetts Institute of Technology

schools.waiver_conditions_en: Not required; strongly recommended for non-native speakers who have used English for fewer than five years or do not speak English at home or in school.

schools.waiver_process_en: English testing is not required, so no waiver is needed.
schools.quote_en: First-year and transfer applicants are not required to take an English proficiency exam

schools.name: Stanford University
schools.other_tests: Scores from any English proficiency exam may be self-reported. No scores stated.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 영어 시험이 필수가 아니라 면제 신청이 필요 없어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: English testing is not required, so no waiver is needed.

schools.name: Yale University
schools.other_tests: Cambridge English (C1 Advanced, C2 Proficiency or B2 First) most competitive 185+; InitialView also accepted as a proficiency option
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 비원어민이라도 영어로 수업하는 중·고등학교에서 2년 이상 공부했다면 영어 시험 제출 대상이 아니에요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Required only of non-native English speakers who have not taken at least two years of secondary education where English is the medium of instruction.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 기준에 해당하면 시험 점수를 내지 않아도 된다고 안내돼요. 별도 신청이 필요한지는 페이지에 나와 있지 않아요.
schools.waiver_process_en: The page says applicants meeting the criteria need not submit scores, but does not say whether any request is needed.

schools.name: Duke University
schools.other_tests: Cambridge C1 Advanced/C2 Proficiency minimum expected 180; PTE Academic minimum expected 70; TOEFL paper-delivered minimum expected 75
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 필수가 아니에요. 비원어민이거나 영어 교육과정이 아닌 학생에게 권장만 해요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Not required; recommended for non-native English speakers or students not currently in an English-medium curriculum.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 영어 시험이 필수가 아니라 면제 신청이 필요 없어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: English testing is not required, so no waiver is needed.
schools.quote_en: we recommend but do not require that you take an English proficiency test

schools.name: Johns Hopkins University
schools.toefl_recommended: To be competitive: minimum 5 total on new 1–6 scale (preferred sub-scores Reading 5.5, Listening 5.5, Writing 5, Speaking 5)
schools.duolingo_recommended: Composite 120+ (preferred sub-scores Literacy 125, Conversation 120, Comprehension 135, Production 105)
schools.other_tests: Cambridge C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency 185+
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 필수가 아니에요. 모국어가 영어가 아니거나 최근 3년간 영어 학교를 다니지 않았다면 권장하고, SAT ERW 690 미만 또는 ACT Reading·English 모두 30 미만이면 제출을 권해요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Recommended (not required) if your primary language is not English or you have not attended an English language school for the last three years; encouraged if SAT ERW below 690 or both ACT Reading and English below 30.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 영어 시험이 필수가 아니라 면제 신청이 필요 없어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: English testing is not required, so no waiver is needed.
schools.quote_en: are recommended if your primary language is not English

schools.name: Northwestern University
schools.toefl_recommended: No minimum; competitive applicants typically score in the high range on all sections
schools.ielts_recommended: No minimum; competitive applicants typically score in the high range
schools.duolingo_recommended: No minimum; competitive applicants typically score in the high range
schools.other_tests: Accepted: DET, IELTS (incl. IELTS Indicator), TOEFL iBT (not TOEFL ITP Plus for China). Official scores only; no self-reporting; no superscoring or MyBest.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 모국어(first/primary language)가 영어가 아니면, 영어로 수업하는 학교에 다녀도 제출 대상이에요. 페이지에 면제 규정은 없어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Required if first/primary language is not English or secondary schooling has not been in English; no exemption for English-medium schooling is listed.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 모국어가 영어가 아니면 제출해야 하고, 면제 절차는 안내돼 있지 않아요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Required whenever first/primary language is not English; no waiver route is described.
schools.quote_en: An English proficiency score is required for applicants whose first/primary language is not English

schools.name: University of Pennsylvania
schools.other_tests: Accepted: TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo English Test. Not accepted: IELTS Indicator, IELTS One Retake, TOEFL MyBest. Official scores only (no self-reporting). No minimum/competitive scores stated on the pages read.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어가 모국어이거나, 입학 시점까지 영어가 주 수업 언어였던 기간이 3년 이상(고교·대학 합산 가능)이면 면제예요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Exempt if English is your native language, or English was your primary language of instruction for at least three years (high school, college, or a combination) by the time you enroll.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 기준에 해당하면 시험 점수를 내지 않아도 된다고 안내돼요. 별도 신청이 필요한지는 페이지에 나와 있지 않아요.
schools.waiver_process_en: The page says applicants meeting the criteria need not submit scores, but does not say whether any request is needed.
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 입학 시점까지 채우면 돼요 (고교·대학 합산 가능)
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Counted by the time you enroll (high school and college combined)

schools.name: California Institute of Technology (Caltech)
schools.other_tests: TOEFL new 1–6 scale (on/after 1/21/2026): minimum 5 total, 5 in each area; TOEFL before 1/21/2026: 25 minimum in each area; IELTS 7 in each area; DET 130 in each area. Exam must be taken before the application deadline. InitialView recommended but does not replace the exam.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어가 모국어이거나 고등학교의 주 수업 언어가 영어이면 필수는 아니에요. 다만 영어 학교에 다니는 비원어민에게도 시험 점수를 강하게 권장해요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Required unless 1) native language is English or 2) English is the primary language of instruction in your secondary school; for non-native speakers in English-medium schools Caltech strongly recommends a score.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 기준에 해당하면 시험 점수를 내지 않아도 된다고 안내돼요. 별도 신청이 필요한지는 페이지에 나와 있지 않아요.
schools.waiver_process_en: The page says applicants meeting the criteria need not submit scores, but does not say whether any request is needed.
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 면제돼도 점수 제출을 강력히 권장해요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Even if exempt, submitting a score is strongly recommended

schools.name: Cornell University
schools.other_tests: TOEFL (Jan 2026 or later) minimum 5.0, recommended 5.5; Cambridge C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency minimum 191. Self-reported scores accepted via Common App or Cornell ELP Form in applicant portal; enrolling students send official scores.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 미국 시민권자·영주권자이거나, 영어가 모국어이거나, 최근 4년간 영어가 주 수업 언어였다면 시험 없이 영어 능력이 인정돼요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Proficiency demonstrated if: U.S. Citizen/Permanent Resident; English is your native language; or English has been the primary language of instruction for the past four years.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 기준에 해당하면 시험 점수를 내지 않아도 된다고 안내돼요. 별도 신청이 필요한지는 페이지에 나와 있지 않아요.
schools.waiver_process_en: The page says applicants meeting the criteria need not submit scores, but does not say whether any request is needed.

schools.name: Brown University
schools.other_tests: TOEFL iBT (January 2026 and later) minimum 5.5; Pearson Test of English minimum 75; Cambridge C1/C2 minimum 191; TOEFL iBT Home Edition accepted; MyBest not accepted
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 필수는 아니지만, 영어가 모국어·가정 언어가 아니거나 고교 전 기간 영어로 수업받지 않은 국제학생에게 강하게 권장해요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Highly recommended for international applicants for whom English is not a first language, a primary home language, or the primary language of instruction for the duration of secondary school.

schools.name: Dartmouth College
schools.toefl_recommended: No minimum; most successful applicants above 100 (before 1/21/2026) or 5+ (on/after 1/21/2026)
schools.ielts_recommended: No minimum; most successful applicants above 7
schools.duolingo_recommended: No minimum; most successful applicants above 135
schools.other_tests: Cambridge English: most successful applicants above 185. TOEFL iBT Special Home Edition and IELTS Indicator accepted; MyBest and TOEFL Essentials not accepted.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 모국어가 영어가 아니어도, 최근 2년 이상 영어로 된 교육과정에서 공부했다면 제출 대상이 아니에요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Required only if your first language is not English and your curriculum has not been delivered in English for at least two years.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 기준에 해당하면 시험 점수를 내지 않아도 된다고 안내돼요. 별도 신청이 필요한지는 페이지에 나와 있지 않아요.
schools.waiver_process_en: The page says applicants meeting the criteria need not submit scores, but does not say whether any request is needed.

schools.name: Columbia University
schools.other_tests: TOEFL (tests on/after 1/21/2026) minimum 5.5; Cambridge C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency minimum 191; IELTS Academic or IELTS Academic for UKVI. MyBest not accepted. Alternatives: SAT Reading and Writing 700+ or ACT English or Reading 29+.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 가정 언어가 영어이거나, 고교 전 기간 주 수업 언어가 영어였거나, SAT Reading and Writing 700점 이상 또는 ACT English·Reading 중 하나가 29점 이상이면 시험 없이 요건을 충족해요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Fulfilled without an exam if: home language is English; primary language of instruction has been English for the duration of secondary school; or SAT Reading and Writing 700+ or ACT English or Reading 29+.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 기준 중 하나에 해당하면 요건을 충족한 것으로 본다고 안내돼요. 별도 신청 절차는 나와 있지 않고, 필요하면 학교가 연락할 수 있다고 해요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Page says meeting any criterion fulfills the requirement; no request step is described, and the office may contact applicants with questions.

schools.name: University of California, Berkeley
schools.other_tests: TOEFL new scale minimum 4.5 ('90/4.5'); AP English Language or Literature 3+; IB English A SL 6–7 or HL 5–7; ACT ELA 24+; SAT Writing and Language 31+ (UC: digital SAT Reading and Writing not approved). Must be satisfied by January 31.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어로 수업받은 기간이 3년 이상이면 요건을 충족해요. 수업 언어가 섞여 있으면(mixed) 인정되지 않아요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Students with 3+ years of Language of Instruction (LOI) in English satisfy the requirement; mixed language of instruction does not.
schools.waiver_process_ko: UC 지원서에 학교별 수업 언어를 정확히 입력하면 그걸로 판단해요. 따로 신청하지 않아요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Determined from the Language of Instruction entered for each school on the UC application; no separate request described.
schools.quote_en: Make sure to select the correct Language of Instruction for each school attended.
schools.score_waiver_note_ko: UC 공통: ACT ELA 24 이상 인정. 디지털 SAT Reading and Writing은 인정하지 않아요

schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 여러 언어를 섞어 수업한 경우는 인정 안 돼요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Mixed language of instruction does not count

schools.name: Rice University
schools.other_tests: TOEFL (on/after 1/21/2026) minimum 5.0 on updated scale (comparable 0–120 score also considered during transition); Cambridge C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency 185; TOEFL iBT Home Edition accepted
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 모국어가 영어가 아니어도, 지원 전까지 영어 교육과정에서 2년 이상 풀타임으로 공부했다면 시험 대신 인정돼요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Applicants whose first language is not English may demonstrate proficiency by completing at least two years of full-time study in an English language curriculum prior to applying.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 기준에 해당하면 시험 점수를 내지 않아도 된다고 안내돼요. 별도 신청이 필요한지는 페이지에 나와 있지 않아요.
schools.waiver_process_en: The page says applicants meeting the criteria need not submit scores, but does not say whether any request is needed.

schools.us_hs_extra_en: Full-time study completed before applying

schools.name: University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA)
schools.toefl_recommended: Competitive: 5+ with sub-scores 5+ (new scale), or above 100 with sub-scores above 24 (old 120-point scale)
schools.other_tests: UC system minimums (UC-wide page): TOEFL 4.5 new scale / 80 old; also AP English Lang/Lit 3+, IB English A SL 6+/HL 5+, ACT ELA 24+, SAT Writing and Language 31+. UCLA says it does not encourage using SAT/ACT for English proficiency. Scores must be self-reported by January.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 고교 교육을 전부 영어로 받았다면 요건이 필요 없어요. 비영어권 국가에서 영어 수업이 3년 미만이면 영어 능력을 증명해야 해요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: If all high school/secondary education was completed in English, you are considered proficient; required if you have had less than 3 years of instruction in English in a non-English-medium country.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 기준에 해당하면 시험 점수를 내지 않아도 된다고 안내돼요. 별도 신청이 필요한지는 페이지에 나와 있지 않아요.
schools.waiver_process_en: The page says applicants meeting the criteria need not submit scores, but does not say whether any request is needed.
schools.score_waiver_note_ko: UC 공통: ACT ELA 24 이상 인정. 디지털 SAT Reading and Writing은 인정하지 않아요 (UCLA는 SAT·ACT로 증명하는 것을 권장하지 않아요)
schools.score_waiver_note_en: UC-wide: ACT ELA 24+ accepted. The digital SAT Reading and Writing is not approved (UCLA discourages using SAT/ACT for this)

schools.name: Vanderbilt University
schools.other_tests: TOEFL Essentials 10.5; Cambridge C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency 185; LanguageCert 75 (all 'recommended minimum'). PTE Academic also listed on testing page. Not superscored.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 모국어나 수업 언어가 영어이면 제출하지 않아도 돼요. ACT English 26점 초과 또는 SAT ERW 630점 초과도 면제예요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Not required if first language or language of instruction is English, or if ACT English above 26 or SAT Evidence-based Reading and Writing above 630.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 기준에 해당하면 시험 점수를 내지 않아도 된다고 안내돼요. 별도 신청이 필요한지는 페이지에 나와 있지 않아요.
schools.waiver_process_en: The page says applicants meeting the criteria need not submit scores, but does not say whether any request is needed.

schools.name: Carnegie Mellon University
schools.other_tests: TOEFL (on/after 1/21/2026) at least 5 overall (sub-scores 5+ considered); TOEFL before 1/21/2026 sub-scores 25+ considered; TOEFL Essentials 11; Cambridge English 191; DET sub-scores 135 each considered; IELTS sub-scores 7.5+. MyBest not used. InitialView/Vericant recommended, not required.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어가 모국어(first language)가 아니면 영어 학교 재학 여부와 관계없이 제출해야 해요. 면제 규정은 안내돼 있지 않아요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Required from all nonnative English speakers; no exemption for English-medium schooling is listed.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 비원어민은 모두 제출해야 하고, 면제 절차는 없어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: All nonnative English speakers must submit a test; no waiver route is described.
schools.quote_en: We require the TOEFL, IELTS, Cambridge or Duolingo English Test from all nonnative English speakers.

schools.name: University of Michigan--Ann Arbor
schools.toefl_recommended: Acceptable range: 100 range with sections 23+ listening & reading, 21+ speaking & writing; new scale 5–6 range with sections 5+ (CEFR C1)
schools.ielts_recommended: Acceptable range: 7.0 range with sections 6.5+ (IELTS Indicator accepted)
schools.other_tests: TOEFL Essentials 10 range (sections 10+); ECPE certificate (all sections C+); CAE (C1 Advanced) 185 (all 180+); CPE (C2 Proficiency) 185 (all 180+); PTE Academic 68; MET 64 (sections 59+). Duolingo English Test is not listed among accepted exams.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: SAT ERW 650 이상(또는 ACT Reading·English 모두 27 이상)이면서, 최근 4년 이상 지정된 영어권 국가에서 공부했을 때만 면제돼요. 해외 미국계·영국계 학교에서 4년 이상 공부하고 점수 기준을 넘으면 면제될 수도 있어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Exempt if SAT EBRW 650+ (or both ACT Reading and English 27+) AND recently completed at least four years of rigorous study in listed English-speaking countries; those in American or British schools abroad may also be exempted with four years of study and qualifying scores.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 기준에 해당하면 시험 점수를 내지 않아도 된다고 안내돼요. 별도 신청이 필요한지는 페이지에 나와 있지 않아요.
schools.waiver_process_en: The page says applicants meeting the criteria need not submit scores, but does not say whether any request is needed.
schools.score_waiver_note_ko: 영어권 지정 국가에서 4년 재학 조건과 함께 충족해야 해요
schools.score_waiver_note_en: Must be combined with 4 years of study in listed English-speaking countries
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: SAT EBRW 650+ 또는 ACT Reading·English 모두 27+도 함께 있어야 해요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Also requires SAT EBRW 650+ or both ACT Reading and English 27+

schools.name: University of Notre Dame
schools.toefl_recommended: Strongly recommended: 100 minimum overall with Speaking 25+ (pre-2026 scale); 5.5 average with no section below 5.0 (updated scale)
schools.other_tests: PTE Academic accepted. TOEFL iBT Special Home Edition not accepted. Scores must come from the testing agency, not uploaded to the portal.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: SAT ERW 650 이상 또는 ACT English·Reading 26 이상이면 면제돼요. 영어로만 수업하는 고등학교에 다니면 이메일로 면제를 문의할 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Waived if SAT EBRW 650+ and/or ACT English or Reading 26+. Students attending a high school where English is the only language of instruction may contact admissions@nd.edu to inquire about a waiver.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 영어 학교 재학을 근거로 한 면제는 admissions@nd.edu로 직접 문의해야 해요. SAT/ACT 점수 기준 면제는 신청 절차가 따로 안내돼 있지 않아요.
schools.waiver_process_en: For an English-medium-school waiver, the student must email admissions@nd.edu; the SAT/ACT-based waiver has no stated request step.
schools.quote_en: please contact admissions@nd.edu to inquire about a waiver.
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: admissions@nd.edu에 문의해서 사례별로 확인받아야 해요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Must email admissions@nd.edu to inquire; case by case

schools.name: Washington University in St. Louis
schools.other_tests: University-wide minimums (OISS): TOEFL iBT 5.0 new scale / 90 old scale; GATEWAY English Test 495. From Fall 2027, SAT/ACT no longer accepted in lieu of English test scores. MyBest not accepted. InitialView strongly encouraged.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어 교육과정 또는 미국 고등학교에서 3년 이상 공부하고 성적이 우수하면 면제될 수 있어요. 온라인 위주 학교는 보통 해당하지 않아요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Students who have completed three or more years of study in an English-medium academic program or high school in the United States with strong academic performance may be exempted; primarily online high schools typically do not qualify.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 면제를 받으려면 admissions@wustl.edu로 직접 요청해야 하고, 개별 검토 후 결정돼요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Students must seek the waiver by contacting admissions@wustl.edu; requests are reviewed case by case.
schools.quote_en: Students may also seek a waiver based on the exemptions listed below.
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 성적이 좋아야 하고, 이메일로 요청해야 해요 (온라인 위주 학교는 제외)
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Strong academic performance; request by email; primarily online schools usually don't qualify

schools.name: Emory University
schools.toefl_recommended: Expected: 100 on 0–120 scale (not a strict cutoff); 5.5+ on new 1–6 scale
schools.ielts_recommended: Expected overall band 7.5 (not a strict cutoff)
schools.other_tests: TOEFL ITP: CEFR C1 expected; TOEFL ITP Plus (Mainland China only) CEFR C1, typically 63–68 per section. Only one exam needed.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: SAT ERW 700 이상, ACT English 30 이상, 또는 최근 4년간 (외국어 과목 제외) 모든 과목을 영어로 수업하는 학교에 다녔다면 시험 없이 인정돼요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Proficiency can be shown by SAT EBRW 700+, ACT English 30+, or spending the most recent four years in a school where English is the language of instruction for all academic subjects (excluding world language).
schools.waiver_process_ko: 기준에 해당하면 시험 점수를 내지 않아도 된다고 안내돼요. 별도 신청이 필요한지는 페이지에 나와 있지 않아요.
schools.waiver_process_en: The page says applicants meeting the criteria need not submit scores, but does not say whether any request is needed.
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 외국어 수업 빼고 모든 과목을 영어로 들어야 해요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: All academic subjects (except world language) taught in English

schools.name: Georgetown University
schools.other_tests: Accepted: DET, IELTS, TOEFL (PBT, iBT and ITP Plus). No scores stated.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 필수가 아니에요. 영어로 수업하지 않는 학교에 다니는 학생에게만 권장해요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Not required; recommended for students who attend a school where English is not the language of instruction.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 영어 시험이 필수가 아니라 면제 신청이 필요 없어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: English testing is not required, so no waiver is needed.
schools.quote_en: Georgetown recommends, but does not require, results from an English language proficiency test

schools.name: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
schools.toefl_recommended: Strong applicants (not minimums): 5+ (on/after 1/21/2026) or 100+ (before 1/21/2026); TOEFL iBT Home Edition accepted
schools.other_tests: Cambridge English C1 Advanced 185+ (C2 Proficiency also accepted). SAT/ACT do not fulfill the requirement.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 입학 시점까지 최근 4년(올해 포함) 이상 영어권 지정 국가에 살았거나, 영어가 주 수업 언어인 학교를 4년 이상 다녔다면 면제될 수 있어요. 영어 성적이나 SAT/ACT로는 면제되지 않아요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: May be waived if, by enrollment, you will have lived at least the last four years (including the current year) in a listed English-primary country, or attended a school where English is the primary language of instruction for at least the last four years (including the current year). Not waived based on English grades or SAT/ACT.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 지원서의 영어 관련 질문 답변으로 판단해 자격이 되면 자동으로 면제돼요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Application questions determine eligibility and the waiver is applied automatically if you qualify.
schools.quote_en: will waive this requirement automatically should you qualify.
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 입학 시점 기준, 현재 학년 포함 최근 4년이에요 (자동 적용)
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Last four years incl. current year, by enrollment; applied automatically

schools.name: University of Southern California
schools.toefl_recommended: Recommended minimum: 100 with no section below 20 (before 21 Jan 2026); 5 with no section below 4 (on/after 21 Jan 2026). Admitted average above 111 with 25+ per section.
schools.other_tests: C1 Advanced 185+ (each skill 169+); PTE 68; SAT EBRW 650 or ACT English 27 also count as approved exams (then cannot apply test-optional). DET only if unable to sit an approved exam; DET-only admits must take USC's International Student Exam (ISE). TOEFL ITP Plus for China not accepted.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 모국어가 영어가 아닌 모든 국제학생은 제출해야 하고, 어떤 경우에도 면제나 예외가 없어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: All international applicants whose native language is not English must submit a USC-approved exam; no waivers or exceptions.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 면제가 없어요. 영어 학교 재학도 면제 사유가 아니에요.
schools.waiver_process_en: No waivers are granted under any circumstances.
schools.quote_en: We do not grant waivers or exceptions to this policy under any circumstances.
schools.score_waiver_note_ko: 승인 시험으로 인정돼요 (이 경우 test-optional로는 지원할 수 없어요)
schools.score_waiver_note_en: Counts as an approved exam (you then can’t apply test-optional)

schools.name: University of California, San Diego
schools.other_tests: TOEFL internet-based minimum 4.5 (effective January 2026) / 83 (before January 2026); AP English Language or Literature 3, 4, 5; IB English A HL 5–7 or SL 6–7
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 모국어가 영어가 아니고, 고교 교육을 영어가 수업 언어가 아닌 나라에서 받았을 때 영어 능력 증명이 필요해요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Demonstration required if your native language is not English and your secondary/high school education was in a country where English is not the language of instruction.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 기준에 해당하면 시험 점수를 내지 않아도 된다고 안내돼요. 별도 신청이 필요한지는 페이지에 나와 있지 않아요.
schools.waiver_process_en: The page says applicants meeting the criteria need not submit scores, but does not say whether any request is needed.

schools.name: University of Florida
schools.other_tests: TOEFL or IELTS (official scores). No minimum scores stated on the undergraduate pages read; Duolingo is not mentioned.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 모국어가 영어가 아니면 TOEFL 또는 IELTS 공식 점수를 내야 해요. 학부 페이지에 면제 규정은 없어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Applicants whose native language is not English must submit official TOEFL or IELTS scores; no exemption is stated on the undergraduate pages.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 모국어가 영어가 아니면 제출 대상이고, 면제 절차는 안내돼 있지 않아요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Required for non-native speakers; no waiver route is described.
schools.quote_en: Applicants whose native language is not English must submit official scores

schools.name: University of Texas at Austin
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어가 유일한 공용어이자 주 사용 언어인 지정 국가(호주·캐나다(퀘벡 제외)·영국·아일랜드·싱가포르·인도 등) 출신이거나, 미국 또는 지정 국가의 고등학교에서 3년 이상 공부하고 졸업하면 면제돼요. 한국은 지정 국가가 아니라서 한국 국제학교 재학만으로는 면제되지 않아요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Exempt if from a qualifying country (English is the sole official and primary conversational language, e.g., Australia, Canada except Quebec, Ireland, Singapore, UK, India), or if graduating from a high school in the U.S. or a qualifying country after at least three years of study.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 면제 신청 방법은 페이지에 안내가 없어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: The page does not say how the exemption is applied.
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 미국 고등학교를 졸업해야 해요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Must graduate from the U.S. high school

schools.name: Georgia Institute of Technology
schools.toefl_recommended: USG recommended 79 (4.0 on new scale); GT may expect more in holistic review
schools.other_tests: USG minimums: SAT EBRW 480, ACT English 17, PTE Academic 53, Cambridge English Scale 169, Michigan English Test 55, EIKEN Pre-1, IGCSE/O-Level English D or better, UK GCSE English C or better. Duolingo/InitialView/Vericant are welcomed as supplements but do NOT satisfy the USG requirement.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: Georgia Tech은 조지아 주립대학 시스템(USG)이 승인한 방법 중 하나로 영어 능력을 증명하게 해요. USG 기준상 영어가 공식 수업 언어인 중등(고교)·대학 학위를 증빙하거나, 미국 인가 대학의 English 1101/1102 과목을 C 이상으로 이수하면 면제될 수 있어요(캠퍼스 심사). SAT EBRW 480·ACT English 17 이상도 인정 방법이에요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Per USG policy: a waiver can be applied for proof of a secondary or collegiate degree where English is the official language of academic instruction, or English 1101/1102 (C or better) at an accredited U.S. institution (per campus review). SAT EBRW 480+/ACT English 17+ are approved methods.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 면제를 어떻게 신청하는지는 Georgia Tech·USG 페이지 모두 안내가 없어요. 점수는 지원서나 지원자 포털에 자가 보고할 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Neither the GT nor the USG page says how the waiver is requested; scores can be self-reported on the application or portal.
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 영어가 공식 수업 언어인 학교의 졸업장이 있어야 하고, 캠퍼스 검토를 거쳐요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Needs a secondary diploma from an English-instruction school; subject to campus review

schools.name: New York University
schools.other_tests: PTE Academic (competitive 70+), Cambridge C1 Advanced/C2 Proficiency (competitive 191+ on Cambridge English Scale). No minimum scores.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어가 모국어(가장 먼저 배우고 가장 잘하는 언어)이거나, 올해 이전 3개 학년 연속으로 모든 수업(제2외국어 제외)을 영어로만 받았다면 시험이 필요 없어요. 반대로 최근 3개 학년 중 영어 외 언어로 된 수업, ESL·ELL·IB English B 수업, 이중언어 과정이 있었다면 필요해요. SAT·ACT·AP·IB 점수로는 면제되지 않아요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Not required if English is your first language OR all schooling for the three full consecutive academic years prior to the current year was taught entirely in English (excluding world language classes). Required if any of those years included non-English coursework, English Language Support coursework (ESL, ELL, IB English B), or a bilingual curriculum. SAT, ACT, AP, IGCSE, A-Levels, IB do not waive it.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 조건에 맞으면 '제출 불필요(Not required)'로만 안내되어 있고, 별도 면제 신청 절차는 언급이 없어요. 학교가 언제든 증빙을 요청할 수 있다고 적혀 있어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Page lists 'Not required if' criteria; no request procedure is described. NYU reserves the right to request proof at any time.
schools.quote_en: NYU Admissions reserves the right to request proof of English language proficiency
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 현재 학년 전 3년 연속, ESL·IB English B·이중언어 과정 없이 모두 영어로 들어야 해요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Three consecutive years before the current year, entirely in English, no ESL/ELL/IB English B/bilingual curriculum

schools.name: University of California, Davis
schools.other_tests: AP English Language/Literature 3+, IB English A SL 6+ / HL 5+, ACT ELA 24+, SAT Writing and Language 31+ (digital SAT Reading and Writing not approved), UC-transferable English composition C+ (UC systemwide)
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: UC Davis 페이지는 '미국에서 3년 미만 공부했고 그 전에 영어가 아닌 언어로 수업을 받은 경우' 영어 증명이 필요하다고 해요. UC 공통 기준은 영어가 수업 언어가 아닌 나라에서 중등교육을 마친 경우 시험이 필요하다고 되어 있어요. AP English Lang/Lit 3점 이상, IB English A 등으로도 증명할 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: UC Davis: must demonstrate proficiency if you studied in the U.S. for fewer than three years and received instruction in a language other than English before you arrived. UC systemwide: exams apply if you completed secondary school in a country where English is not the language of instruction. AP/IB English, ACT/SAT sections, or college English composition also count.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 면제·판정 절차는 안내가 없어요. 점수는 UC 지원서에 자가 보고해요. 영어로 수업받은 한국 국제학교 학생에게 해당하는지는 페이지 문구만으로는 분명하지 않아요.
schools.waiver_process_en: No waiver procedure described; scores are self-reported on the UC application.
schools.score_waiver_note_ko: UC 공통: ACT ELA 24 이상 인정. 디지털 SAT Reading and Writing은 인정하지 않아요
schools.score_waiver_note_en: UC-wide: ACT ELA 24+ accepted. The digital SAT Reading and Writing is not approved

schools.name: University of California, Irvine
schools.other_tests: AP English Language/Literature 3+, IB English A SL 6+ / HL 5+, ACT ELA 24+, SAT Writing and Language 31+ (digital SAT Reading and Writing not approved), UC-transferable English composition C+ , SAT EBRW 680+ (UCI page)
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어 시험 필요 여부는 국적이 아니라 고교 수업 언어로 정해져요. 고교 일부라도 영어가 아닌 언어로 수업하는 학교에 다녔거나, 졸업 시점까지 영어 수업 기간이 3년 미만이면 증명이 필요해요. AP·IB English, SAT EBRW 680 이상 등으로도 증명할 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Need is determined by language of instruction, not citizenship. Required if any high school was at an institution where English was not the language of instruction, or if you had less than three years of instruction in English by graduation. AP/IB English, ACT ELA 24+, SAT EBRW 680+ etc. also satisfy it.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 별도 면제 신청 절차는 안내가 없어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: No waiver request procedure described.
schools.quote_en: not determined by citizenship, but rather by one's language of instruction
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 고등학교 과정 중 영어가 아닌 언어로 수업한 학교가 있으면 안 돼요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: No high school attended may have non-English instruction

schools.name: Boston College
schools.toefl_recommended: Recommended minimum 100 (5.0 on new scale); admitted students average 5.5 on new scale
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어가 모국어이거나, 미국 또는 영어 원어민이 다수인 나라의 고교에서 ESOL 없이 3년 이상 다녔거나, SAT EBRW 650 이상 또는 ACT English 29 이상이면 면제돼요. 한국 국제학교 재학만으로는 해당하지 않아서 SAT/ACT 점수가 현실적인 면제 경로예요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Waived if: English is your native language; or 3+ years at a U.S. high school or another majority native English speaking country in a traditional curriculum without ESOL; or SAT EBRW 650+ / ACT English 29+.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 면제 조건만 안내되어 있고 신청 방법은 언급이 없어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Only criteria listed; the page does not say how the waiver is obtained.
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: ESOL 없는 일반 교육과정이어야 해요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Traditional curriculum without ESOL

schools.name: Tufts University
schools.other_tests: PTE Academic (generally 68+). TOEFL ITP Plus and IELTS Indicator not accepted.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어를 주 수업 언어로 하는 중등학교에서 3년 이상 공부했다면 영어 시험을 제출하지 않아도 돼요(원하면 제출 가능). 단, 중등 과정에서 ESOL 수업을 들었다면 증빙을 요청받을 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Applicants with at least three years at a secondary school where the primary language is English do not need to submit testing (optional). Students in ESOL classes may be asked for proof.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 페이지에 '제출할 필요 없음'으로만 적혀 있고, 별도 신청 절차는 언급이 없어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Page says such students 'do not need to submit'; no request step is mentioned.
schools.quote_en: do not need to submit English proficiency testing, though they may if they would like
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: ESOL 수업을 들었다면 증빙을 요청받을 수 있어요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Students in ESOL classes may be asked for proof

schools.name: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
schools.ielts_recommended: Typical 7.5–8 total, at least 6 in each module
schools.other_tests: ACT or SAT may be submitted instead (then used for all aspects of review); if ACT/SAT reported, TOEFL/IELTS/IELTS Indicator/DET still strongly encouraged.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 최근 3년(10~12학년)을 영어가 공용어인 지정 국가(미국 본토·영국·캐나다(퀘벡 제외)·호주 등)에서 마치지 않았다면 TOEFL·IELTS·Duolingo·ACT·SAT 중 하나를 꼭 내야 해요. 한국은 지정 국가가 아니고, 이 요건은 면제되지 않아요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: If you did not complete Grades 10–12 in an approved English-speaking country, you must submit TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo, ACT, or SAT. This requirement cannot be waived.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 면제 제도가 없어요. 영어 시험이나 SAT/ACT 점수를 내야 해요.
schools.waiver_process_en: No waiver; submit an English test or SAT/ACT.
schools.quote_en: This requirement cannot be waived.
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 10~12학년을 미국 본토에서 마쳐야 해요 (푸에르토리코 등 미국령 제외)
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Grades 10-12 completed in the mainland U.S. (not Puerto Rico/territories)

schools.name: University of Wisconsin--Madison
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 중등학교 4년 내내 영어가 주 수업 언어였다면 면제받을 수 있어요. IB HL English·AP English·ACT·SAT·Cambridge·PTE 점수로는 면제되지 않아요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Waivable if English was the primary language of instruction in all four years of secondary school. IB HL English, AP English, ACT, SAT, Cambridge, PTE cannot be used to waive.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 지원 후 Student Center의 Student eForms에서 'ELP Waiver Request' 양식을 직접 제출해야 해요. 성적표가 접수된 뒤 검토하며 최대 14영업일 걸릴 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Submit the 'ELP Waiver Request' form in Student eForms (Student Center) after applying; reviewed after transcript is received (up to 14 business days).
schools.quote_en: select “ELP Waiver Request” and complete the form
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: ELP Waiver Request 양식을 제출해야 해요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Must submit the ELP Waiver Request form

schools.name: University of California, Santa Barbara
schools.other_tests: AP English Language/Literature 3+, IB English A SL 6+ / HL 5+, ACT ELA 24+, SAT Writing and Language 31+ (digital SAT Reading and Writing not approved), UC-transferable English composition C+
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 모국어가 영어가 아니면서, 영어가 수업 언어가 아닌 나라에서 교육받았거나 영어 수업 기간이 3년 미만이면 증명이 필요해요. AP·IB English, ACT ELA 24 이상 등으로도 증명할 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Required if your native language is not English AND your education was in a country where the language of instruction was not English, or you have fewer than three years of instruction in English. AP/IB English, ACT ELA 24+, SAT W&L 31+ also count.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 별도 면제 신청 절차는 안내가 없어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: No waiver procedure described.
schools.score_waiver_note_ko: UC 공통: ACT ELA 24 이상 인정. 디지털 SAT Reading and Writing은 인정하지 않아요
schools.score_waiver_note_en: UC-wide: ACT ELA 24+ accepted. The digital SAT Reading and Writing is not approved

schools.name: Ohio State University
schools.other_tests: SAT EBRW 550+, ACT English 21+, IELTS Indicator 6.5+
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 미국 정규 인가 고교에서 3년 이상 다니고 졸업했거나, 지정 영어권 국가(미국·영국·캐나다(퀘벡 제외)·호주·싱가포르 등) 시민권자·학사 학위 보유자면 충족돼요. 한국 국제학교 학생은 해당하지 않아 시험이나 SAT EBRW 550·ACT English 21 이상으로 증명해야 해요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Met by approved test score (incl. SAT EBRW 550+/ACT English 21+), 3 full years and graduation from a U.S. regionally accredited high school, or citizenship/bachelor's degree from listed countries.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 별도 면제 신청 절차는 안내가 없어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: No waiver request procedure described.
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 졸업까지 해야 해요 (미국 정규 인증 고교)
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Must graduate (U.S. regionally accredited high school)

schools.name: Boston University
schools.toefl_recommended: Most competitive: 90–100+ composite with 20+ per section (old scale); 5.0+ (new scale from 2026-01-21)
schools.ielts_recommended: 7.0+ satisfies BU's requirement for all programs
schools.other_tests: IELTS Indicator, TOEFL ITP Plus, TOEFL Essentials, IELTS One Skill Retake not accepted.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 모국어가 영어가 아니면 시험이 필요해요. 페이지에 구체적인 면제 기준은 없고, 면제 여부는 입학사정위원회 재량으로 정해요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Required if your first language is not English. No specific waiver criteria listed; waiver is at the discretion of the Board of Admissions.
schools.waiver_process_ko: English Proficiency Waiver Request Form을 작성해 지원 마감일까지 완성된 지원서와 함께 제출해야 해요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Complete the English Proficiency Waiver Request Form; must be received by the application deadline with a complete application.
schools.quote_en: To submit a waiver request, please complete the English Proficiency Waiver Request Form

schools.name: Rutgers University--New Brunswick
schools.other_tests: SAT EBRW 550, ACT English 21, PTE 53, Michigan English Test 56, Cambridge B2. New Brunswick TOEFL new-scale 4.5. Pharmacy/Nursing: TOEFL 100 (old) / 5.5 (new), DET 130.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어로 수업하는 학교(English medium school)에 다닌 경우 개별 심사로 면제받을 수 있어요. 미국 인가 대학의 영작문 과목을 B 이상으로 이수하면 면제예요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: May be waived for students who attended an English medium school, evaluated case-by-case. Exempt with B or better in college-level English Composition at an accredited U.S. college.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 지원서를 완성한 뒤 RUinternational@admissions.rutgers.edu로 이메일을 보내 면제 검토를 요청해야 해요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Email RUinternational@admissions.rutgers.edu to request a waiver review of your completed application.
schools.quote_en: To request a review of your completed admissions application for a waiver, please contact us

schools.name: University of Maryland, College Park
schools.other_tests: IELTS Indicator accepted. Scores at or below MEI thresholds (TOEFL 94/4.5, IELTS 6.5, DET 115) may lead to required Maryland English Institute coursework.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 미국 고교 또는 미국 인가(U.S. accredited) 고교에서 ESL 수업 없이 4년을 마쳤거나, 미국 대학 학위·55학점 이상 이수, 또는 영어가 모국어이면서 지정 영어권 국가 시민권·학위가 있으면 면제를 고려해요. 미국 인가를 받은 한국 국제학교가 여기에 해당하는지는 페이지에 따로 설명이 없어 학교에 확인이 필요해요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: May consider waiving if, by the deadline: four years at a U.S. high school or U.S. accredited high school without ESL coursework; a U.S. degree; 55+ U.S. semester credits incl. English Comp 1 & 2; or English is your first language with citizenship/degree from listed English-speaking countries.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 면제를 어떻게 신청하는지는 안내가 없어요. 지원서 전체를 보고 입학처가 판단한다고만 적혀 있어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: No request procedure described; the office reviews the full file to determine proficiency.
schools.quote_en: we may consider waiving the English proficiency test requirement
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: ESL 수업 없이, 마감일까지 채워야 해요 (면제는 재량 검토)
schools.us_hs_extra_en: No ESL coursework, by the deadline; waiver is discretionary

schools.name: University of Washington (Seattle)
schools.other_tests: Alternative: SAT EBRW 580+ or ACT English 22+ AND B average in all HS English writing/literature courses at a school where English is the language of instruction for all grades 10–12 (official SAT/ACT scores required). TOEFL iBT special home edition and IELTS Indicator accepted.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 초·중등 교육을 모두 호주·캐나다(영어권 주)·영국·아일랜드·뉴질랜드·미국에서 받은 경우만 면제예요. 대신 10~12학년 전 과목을 영어로 가르치는 학교에서 영어 과목 평균 B 이상이고 SAT EBRW 580 또는 ACT English 22 이상이면 요건을 충족한 것으로 봐요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Exempt only if primary and secondary education took place in Australia, Canada (English-speaking provinces), UK, Ireland, New Zealand, or the U.S. Alternative: B average in HS English courses (English-medium school for grades 10–12) plus SAT EBRW 580+ or ACT English 22+.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 면제 신청 절차 안내는 없어요. SAT/ACT 대안은 공식 점수를 UW로 보내면 적용돼요. 12월 31일까지 기준을 못 채우면 심사 대상에서 제외돼요.
schools.waiver_process_en: No waiver request procedure; SAT/ACT alternative applies when official scores are sent. Applicants not meeting the requirement by Dec 31 are not considered.
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 초·중·고 전 과정을 미국 등에서 해야 해요. 아니면 10~12학년 영어 과목 B 평균 + SAT EBRW 580/ACT English 22
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Primary AND secondary in listed countries; alternative: B avg in HS English (grades 10-12) + SAT EBRW 580+/ACT English 22+

schools.name: Lehigh University
schools.toefl_recommended: Most competitive above 90; 95+ (old) / 5.5+ (new) indicates strong proficiency; 86–94 / 4.0–5.0 may need support
schools.other_tests: SAT, SAT Subject Test and ACT cannot be used to meet the requirement. TOEFL/IELTS preferred; TOEFL Home Edition and DET considered if those are unavailable.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어가 모국어이거나, 올해를 제외한 최근 2개 학년 동안 정규 수업을 영어로 받았다면 시험을 제출하지 않아도 돼요. SAT·ACT로는 대체할 수 없어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Required unless the applicant's first language is English, or the last two full years (not including the current year) of completed formal instruction have been in English.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 면제 신청 방법은 안내가 없어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: The page does not say how the exemption is applied.
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 현재 학년을 빼고 최근 2년이에요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Last two full completed years, not counting the current year

schools.name: Northeastern University
schools.toefl_recommended: No minimum; admitted middle 50%: 102–110 (on/before 2026-01-20); 5.0–5.5 overall and subscores (on/after 2026-01-21)
schools.other_tests: Cambridge C1 Advanced/C2 Proficiency (middle 50% 195–202), PTE Academic (79–86). IELTS Indicator, PTE Online, TOEFL Essentials/ITP/Paper not accepted.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 입학 직전까지 영어가 주 수업 언어인 학교에서 4년 연속 풀타임으로 공부하면 면제받을 수 있어요. AP English 4~5점, IB English A 5점 이상 등의 결과를 함께 내는 것을 강하게 권장해요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Waived if you will complete 4 consecutive full-time academic years at institutions where native English was the primary instructional language immediately before enrolling; AP/IB/IGCSE/A-Level English results strongly encouraged.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 지원 후 Application Status Check 포털에서 면제 요청(waiver request)을 직접 제출해야 해요. 보통 3~5영업일 안에 검토해요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Submit a waiver request through the Application Status Check portal; typically reviewed within 3–5 business days.
schools.quote_en: You submit a waiver request through your Application Status Check portal.
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 입학 직전 연속 4년 full-time이어야 하고, 포털에서 신청해야 해요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Four consecutive full-time years right before enrolling; request via portal

schools.name: Purdue University--Main Campus
schools.other_tests: ACT English 26+ or SAT EBRW 600+ (required minimums). TOEFL requires 20+ per section (old) or 4.5 overall with 4.0+ each section (new). IELTS Online/Indicator accepted.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어로 가르치는 교육과정에서 3년 이상 공부하고, 영어 과목 모두 B 이상, 전체 성적이 우수하면 시험 대신 고려될 수 있어요. SAT EBRW 600·ACT English 26 이상으로도 증명할 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: A completed English-taught curriculum may be considered: at least three years of English-taught curriculum, B or better in all English courses, strong overall performance. SAT EBRW 600+ / ACT English 26+ also accepted.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 별도 신청 절차는 없고 지원서 심사 중에 영어 능력을 평가한다고만 적혀 있어요. 시험 없이 합격하면 입학 후 영어 배치고사를 볼 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Proficiency is evaluated during application review; no request step described. Students admitted without a formal exam may take an English placement exam.
schools.quote_en: will be evaluated for English language proficiency during the application review process
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 모든 영어 과목 B 이상, 전체 성적 우수해야 해요 (검토 후 인정)
schools.us_hs_extra_en: B or better in all English courses and strong overall performance; considered, not automatic

schools.name: University of Georgia
schools.other_tests: Most first-years meet proficiency with SAT or ACT (required by Board of Regents). Admitted international averages: SAT EBRW 650, ACT English 30.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 대부분의 학생은 조지아 주 이사회(Board of Regents)가 요구하는 SAT·ACT 점수로 영어 능력을 충족해요. IELTS·TOEFL은 추가로 제출할 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Most students meet proficiency through SAT or ACT scores required by the Board of Regents; IELTS or TOEFL may also be submitted.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 별도 면제 절차 없이 SAT/ACT로 충족하는 구조예요.
schools.waiver_process_en: No separate waiver; SAT/ACT generally satisfies proficiency.
schools.quote_en: Most students meet proficiency through SAT or ACT scores required by the Board of Regents.
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: SAT/ACT 점수로 영어 능력을 확인해요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Proficiency is generally shown through required SAT/ACT scores

schools.name: University of Rochester
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어 원어민이거나, 영어가 주 수업 언어인 고교에서 3년 이상 공부했다면 면제를 신청할 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Eligible to request a waiver if you are a native speaker of English or completed at least three years of high school where English was the primary language of instruction.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 지원서 제출 후 English Proficiency Waiver Request Form을 지원 마감일까지 내야 해요. 성적표 접수 후 검토하고 승인되면 지원 상태가 자동으로 바뀌어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Submit the English Proficiency Waiver Request Form after applying, by the application deadline; reviewed after application and transcript are received.
schools.quote_en: Waiver requests will be reviewed after the submission of an application and transcript.
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 면제 신청서를 마감일까지 내야 해요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Must submit the waiver request form by the deadline

schools.name: Case Western Reserve University
schools.other_tests: PTE Academic 61; TOEFL paper-based 577 (on/before 2026-01-20)
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 졸업 시점까지 영어로 수업하는 학교에 2년 이상 다녔거나, SAT EBRW 630 이상 또는 ACT English 26 이상이면 자동으로 면제돼요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Automatically waived if you attend a school where the language of instruction is English for two years by graduation, or score SAT EBRW 630+, or ACT English 26+.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 기준을 충족하면 자동으로 면제돼요. 별도 신청은 필요 없다고 안내돼 있어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Automatically waived when any one standard is met.
schools.quote_en: can be automatically waived if you meet any one of these standards
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 졸업 시점까지 채우면 자동 면제예요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: By graduation; waived automatically

schools.name: Florida State University
schools.other_tests: PTE 55, Michigan Language Assessment 55, Cambridge C1 Advanced/C2 Proficiency 180
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 모국어가 영어가 아닌 모든 국제학생에게 필요해요. 1학년 지원자를 위한 면제 조건은 페이지에 없어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Required of all international applicants whose native language is not English. No first-year waiver criteria are listed.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 면제 제도나 절차 안내가 없어요. 점수는 지원자 포털에 자가 보고할 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: No waiver or procedure described; scores can be self-reported on the Admissions Portal.

schools.name: Texas A&M University
schools.other_tests: TOEFL Essentials 8.5, SAT EBRW 560+, ACT English 21+
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 지정 영어권 국가(영국·호주·캐나다(퀘벡 제외)·아일랜드·뉴질랜드 등) 시민권자이거나 미국 고교에서 4년을 모두 마치면 면제예요. 한국 국제학교 학생은 시험이나 SAT EBRW 560·ACT English 21 이상으로 증명해야 해요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Exempt if a citizen of listed countries (e.g., UK, Australia, Canada except Quebec, Ireland, New Zealand) or completing all four years at a U.S. high school. Otherwise TOEFL/IELTS/SAT EBRW 560+/ACT English 21+.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 면제 신청 방법은 안내가 없어요. 지정 국가 시민권자는 'ELP Verified'로 본다고만 적혀 있어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: No request procedure described; citizens of listed countries are considered 'ELP Verified'.
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 4년 모두 미국 고등학교에서 다녀야 해요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: All four years at a U.S. high school

schools.name: Virginia Tech
schools.other_tests: PTE 59, Cambridge 176, SAT EBRW 550+, ACT English 24+, IGCSE/GCSE/GCE English First Language or English Language A–C (6–9), IB English A 5+. TOEFL needs no subsection below 16 (old) / 4.0 (new).
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 지정 영어권 국가(미국·영국·캐나다(퀘벡 제외)·호주·싱가포르 등)에서 9~12학년 4년을 영어로만 공부하고 ESL을 듣지 않았다면 제출하지 않아도 돼요. 한국 국제학교는 해당하지 않지만 SAT EBRW 550·ACT English 24·IB English A 5 이상 등으로 증명할 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Not required if four years (grades 9–12) were completed in a listed native English-speaking country with English as the only medium of instruction and no ESL. Otherwise submit one listed test (incl. SAT/ACT/IB/IGCSE options).
schools.waiver_process_ko: 페이지에 '제출할 필요 없음'으로만 적혀 있고 신청 절차는 언급이 없어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Page says such students 'do not need to submit'; no request step mentioned.
schools.quote_en: they do not need to submit verification of English language proficiency
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 9~12학년 영어로만 수업, ESL 수업 없이
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Grades 9-12, English-only instruction, no ESL

schools.name: Wake Forest University
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어가 주 수업 언어인 학교에서 3년 이상 공부했다면 면제돼요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Waived for students in schools where English is the main language of instruction (3 years minimum).
schools.waiver_process_ko: 면제 신청 방법은 안내가 없어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: The page does not say how the waiver is applied.
schools.quote_en: will be waived for students in schools where English is the main language of instruction

schools.name: William & Mary
schools.toefl_recommended: Generally looking for a minimum of 100 (on/before 2026-01-20) or 5 (on/after 2026-01-21); MyBest accepted
schools.duolingo_recommended: Accepted if TOEFL/IELTS not accessible; no score stated
schools.other_tests: InitialView, Duolingo or Vericant interview can be submitted.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 모국어가 영어가 아니고 최근 4년 이상 영어가 아닌 언어로 공부했다면 TOEFL·IELTS를 강하게 권장해요. 집에서 다른 언어를 쓰는 학생도 제출을 고려하라고 해요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Strongly recommended if English is not your native language and your schooling in the past four years or more has been in a language other than English; students speaking another language at home should strongly consider submitting.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 필수가 아닌 권장 사항이라 면제 절차가 없어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Testing is strongly recommended, not required; no waiver process.
schools.quote_en: William & Mary strongly recommends you take the Test of English as a Foreign Language

schools.name: University of California, Merced
schools.other_tests: Mixed-record first-years: ACT English/Writing or ELA 24+, SAT Writing 560+ or Writing and Language 31+, AP English Lang/Lit 3+, IB SL English 6+ / HL 5+
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: UC Merced 페이지에는 면제 조건이 없어요. UC 공통 기준은 영어가 수업 언어가 아닌 나라에서 중등교육을 마친 경우 시험이 필요하다고 해요. AP·IB English, ACT, SAT로도 증명할 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: UC Merced page lists no waiver; UC systemwide page applies exam route to those who completed secondary school in a country where English is not the language of instruction. AP/IB/ACT/SAT alternatives listed.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 면제 절차 안내가 없어요. 1월까지 점수가 도착해야 해요.
schools.waiver_process_en: No waiver procedure described; results must arrive by January for fall.
schools.score_waiver_note_ko: UC 공통: ACT ELA 24 이상 인정. 디지털 SAT Reading and Writing은 인정하지 않아요
schools.score_waiver_note_en: UC-wide: ACT ELA 24+ accepted. The digital SAT Reading and Writing is not approved

schools.name: Villanova University
schools.other_tests: Cambridge English, PTE Academic also accepted
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어가 모국어이고 집에서도 영어를 쓰거나, 지원 시점까지 영어가 주 수업 언어인 중등학교에 3년 넘게 연속 재학했다면 면제될 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: May be waived if English is a native language and spoken in the home, or enrollment of more than three consecutive years at application where English is the primary language of instruction in secondary school.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 면제 신청 방법은 안내가 없어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: The page does not say how the waiver is applied.
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 지원 시점 기준 3년 넘게 연속이어야 해요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: More than three consecutive years at the time of application

schools.name: George Washington University
schools.other_tests: PTE Academic 61. EAP course may be waived with TOEFL 100 (old) / 5 (new), IELTS 7.5, or DET 130.
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: SAT EBRW 650 이상, ACT English 29 이상, 또는 입학 시점까지 최근 4년간 영어가 주 수업 언어인 학교에서 중등교육을 마치면 면제받을 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Waivable with SAT EBRW 650+, ACT English 29+, or (first-year) most recent 4 years of secondary education at an institution where English is the primary language of instruction by enrollment.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 지원서 제출 후 입학 포털에서 면제 요청을 직접 제출해야 해요. 마감일까지 점수나 면제 요청 중 하나를 내야 하고, 서류가 갖춰지면 1주일 안에 검토해요.
schools.waiver_process_en: After applying, submit a waiver request in the admissions portal by the deadline; reviewed within one week once documents are received.
schools.quote_en: waiver will be available to students in the admissions portal after they submit
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 입학 시점까지 최근 4년, 포털에서 신청해야 해요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Most recent four years by enrollment; request in portal

schools.name: Pennsylvania State University--University Park
schools.other_tests: SAT EBRW 570+, ACT English 24+, GCSE/GCE English language A–C, IB English A (Language & Literature) 5+, 4 years in a U.S. high school, Penn State IECP certification
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 모국어가 영어가 아닌 국제학생은 모두 증명해야 해요. 영어 수업 학교 재학은 면제 사유로 나와 있지 않고, 대신 SAT EBRW 570·ACT English 24·IB English A 5 이상, 미국 고교 4년 등으로 증명할 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: All international students whose native language is not English must submit proof; U.S. citizens/permanent residents are not required. English-medium schooling abroad is not listed as a waiver; alternatives include SAT EBRW 570+, ACT English 24+, IB English A 5+, GCSE/GCE English A–C, 4 years in a U.S. high school.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 면제 신청 제도나 절차 안내가 없어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: No waiver request procedure described.

schools.name: Santa Clara University
schools.other_tests: SAT EBRW 630; ACT Reading 27 and ACT English 27. TOEFL new scale (after Jan 21, 2026): 4.5
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어권 또는 비영어권 국가에서 '영어로만 수업하는 학교'를 4년 다닌 경우 영어 시험 없이 영어 능력을 인정받아요. SAT EBRW 630 이상 또는 ACT Reading·English 각 27 이상으로도 인정돼요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Attending secondary school (in an anglophone or non-anglophone country) AND completing 4 years at a school where the sole language of instruction was English; or SAT EBRW 630 / ACT Reading 27 and English 27.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 지원서 제출 후 지원자 포털의 English Proficiency 양식에서 해당 기준(4년 영어 수업 학교 등)을 직접 선택·제출해야 해요.
schools.waiver_process_en: After submitting the application, complete the English Proficiency form in the applicant portal to show which criterion you meet.
schools.quote_en: Applicants are able to do so through the English Proficiency form in their applicant portal
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 영어로만 수업하는 학교여야 하고, 포털에서 양식을 내야 해요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: School with English as sole language of instruction; submit portal form

schools.name: Stony Brook University (SUNY)
schools.other_tests: TOEFL new scale (after 1/21/2026): 4; SAT EBRW 480; ACT English 19; AP English Lang/Lit 3; IB English HL 5; A-level English C; PTE Academic 53; GaoKao 125/150; CSAT Rank 1
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어권 국가 출신이거나 영어로 수업하는 학교(English-medium school)에 다니는 국제학생은 영어 시험 제출이 면제돼요. SAT·ACT·AP·IB 영어 점수로도 요건을 충족할 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Applicants from native English-speaking countries are exempt, as are international applicants who attend an English-medium school. Requirement can also be met by SAT EBRW 480, ACT English 19, AP English 3, IB English HL 5, A-level English C, etc.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 페이지에 면제 신청 절차 안내가 없어요. 영어 수업 학교임을 어떻게 확인하는지 입학처에 확인하는 게 좋아요.
schools.waiver_process_en: The page states the exemption but not how it is applied or confirmed; confirm with admissions.
schools.quote_en: international applicants who attend an English-medium school

schools.name: University of Minnesota, Twin Cities
schools.other_tests: TOEFL iBT 4.5 is on the new 1–6 scale (writing subscore 4.5); PTE Academic 59; Cambridge C1 Advanced 180; ACT English & Reading 21 + Writing 8, SAT EBRW 540 (digital SAT R&W 550) can exempt
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어권 국가 출신, AP English·A-level English·IB English Language and Literature 등 심화 영어 과목 이수, ACT(English·Reading 21+, Writing 8+) 또는 SAT(디지털 R&W 550+) 기준 충족 시 면제될 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Exempt countries list; completion of accelerated English coursework such as AP English, A-level English or IB English Language and Literature; ACT English & Reading 21 and Writing 8, or SAT EBRW 540 (digital SAT R&W 550); U.S. transfer coursework.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 입학처가 지원서(STARS 성적 등)를 보고 먼저 판단하고, 시험이 필요하면 Application Tracker로 알려줘요. 그래도 요청받았는데 사유가 있으면 Exemption Request Form을 낼 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Admissions evaluates exemption criteria before asking for a test; Application Tracker shows if a test is required. If still asked, you may submit the Exemption Request Form.
schools.quote_en: Our Admissions staff will evaluate these items before asking an applicant to complete a test.
schools.score_waiver_note_ko: ACT는 English·Reading 21 이상 + Writing 8 (디지털 SAT R&W는 550)
schools.score_waiver_note_en: ACT English & Reading 21+ and Writing 8 (digital SAT R&W 550)
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 미국 고교 재학만으로는 면제 안 돼요. AP/IB English 이수나 SAT/ACT 점수로는 면제될 수 있어요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: U.S. high school attendance alone doesn't exempt visa holders; AP/IB English or SAT/ACT routes exist

schools.name: Amherst College
schools.other_tests: TOEFL iBT / Home Edition, IELTS Academic, DET only
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 최근 2년간 영어가 주 수업 언어인 학교에서 공부했거나 영어가 모국어인 경우에만 면제돼요. 그 외 사유로는 면제가 없어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Only first-year applicants who completed the two most recent years of secondary education at a school with English as the primary language of instruction, or native English speakers. No other basis.
schools.waiver_process_ko: Common App·Scoir 지원자는 Amherst 추가 질문(supplement)에 답해 면제 자격을 밝혀야 하고, 그 외 지원자는 포털의 면제 자격 확인서(attestation form)를 제출해요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Common App/Scoir applicants answer waiver-eligibility questions on the Amherst supplement; others complete an attestation form in the applicant portal.
schools.quote_en: answer a series of questions on the Amherst supplement to determine waiver eligibility
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 최근 2년이고, Amherst 보충 질문 답변이나 확인서가 필요해요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Two most recent years; answer supplement questions or attestation form

schools.name: Swarthmore College
schools.other_tests: TOEFL, IELTS, DET accepted; alternatives: Swarthmore Video Response or InitialView/Vericant video
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어 시험 자체는 필수가 아니에요. 다만 미국 밖 학교 재학생은 (국적과 무관하게) Swarthmore Video Response, 영어 시험 점수, InitialView·Vericant 영상 중 하나를 반드시 내야 해요. 대부분 교육을 비영어 커리큘럼으로 받았다면 시험 제출을 권장해요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Not a waiver system. Applicants attending school outside the U.S., regardless of citizenship, must submit one of: Swarthmore Video Response, English Proficiency Exam result, or InitialView/Vericant video. Test encouraged if majority of education was in a non-English curriculum.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 면제 절차는 없어요. 대신 세 가지(비디오 응답·영어 시험·InitialView 등) 중 하나를 선택해 제출하면 돼요. 비디오 응답은 지원 후 포털에서 무료로 녹화해요.
schools.waiver_process_en: No waiver needed; submit one of the three options. The free Video Response is recorded in the applicant portal after applying.
schools.quote_en: required to submit one of the following: Swarthmore Video Response

schools.name: Bowdoin College
schools.other_tests: Cambridge English Assessment (CEA) also accepted
schools.waiver_process_ko: 영어 시험 제출은 선택이라 면제 신청이 필요 없어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: English proficiency test submission is optional; no waiver needed.
schools.quote_en: It is optional to submit English proficiency test scores.

schools.name: Claremont McKenna College
schools.other_tests: Cambridge English C1 Advanced / C2 Proficiency 190 (minimum recommended). TOEFL Essentials not accepted
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어가 모국어이거나, 영어가 주 수업 언어인 학교를 최소 3년 다닌 경우 영어 시험이 필요 없어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Required unless first language is English or the applicant attends a school in which English is the primary language of instruction for a minimum of three years.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 지원서 체크리스트에서 자동으로 면제되지 않았다면, CMC 지원자 포털에 뜨는 면제 요청서(waiver request form)를 제출해야 해요.
schools.waiver_process_en: If not automatically waived on the application checklist, submit the waiver request form in the CMC applicant portal.
schools.quote_en: not automatically waived on their application checklist, they can submit a waiver request form
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 체크리스트에서 자동 면제 안 되면 포털에서 신청해야 해요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: If not auto-waived on checklist, request via portal form

schools.name: Pomona College
schools.other_tests: TOEFL new scale min 5 (shown on international page); TOEFL ITP Plus for China Solution 627; no subscore minimums
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 중등학교의 주 수업 언어가 영어라면 영어 시험 제출 대상이 아니에요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Required only if English is not the primary language of instruction in your secondary school.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 영어 수업 학교 여부로 제출 대상이 정해진다는 설명만 있고, 별도 면제 신청 절차는 안내돼 있지 않아요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Requirement applies only to non-English-medium schools; the page does not describe a waiver request process.
schools.quote_en: If English is not the primary language of instruction in your secondary school

schools.name: Wellesley College
schools.other_tests: TOEFL iBT or Essentials, DET, IELTS, Cambridge C1 Advanced/C2 Proficiency/C1 Business Higher, GTEC CBT; or InitialView / Vericant interview
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 필수는 아니에요. 영어가 모국어가 아니고 영어 커리큘럼 수학 기간이 4년 미만이면 시험이나 인터뷰 도구 활용을 강하게 권장해요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Not required. Strongly recommended if English is not your native language and you have studied in an English-based curriculum for fewer than four years.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 영어 시험은 선택이라 면제 신청이 필요 없어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: English proficiency exams are optional; no waiver needed.
schools.quote_en: English-language proficiency exams (optional)

schools.name: Carleton College
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 집에서 영어를 쓰거나, 최근 4년간 영어로 수업을 받았다면 시험을 내지 않아도 돼요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Test should be submitted only if you do not speak English at home AND your classes have not been taught in English for the last four years.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 두 질문(집에서 영어 사용 / 4년 영어 수업)에 모두 '아니오'인 경우에만 제출하라는 안내뿐, 면제 신청 절차는 없어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: The page only says to submit scores if both conditions are 'no'; no waiver request process described.
schools.quote_en: If you answered no to both questions, you should submit results

schools.name: Harvey Mudd College
schools.other_tests: Cambridge C1 Advanced 190 / C2 Proficiency 200; DET only 160-point version
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 다니는 학교의 주 수업 언어가 영어이거나 영어가 모국어이면 면제돼요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Waived if the school the student attends uses English as the primary language of instruction, or if English is the student's first language.
schools.waiver_process_ko: Common App 제출 후 입학처에 이메일로 면제를 요청해야 해요. 지원서 제출 전에는 면제가 불가능해요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Email the admission office to request the waiver; it can only be waived after your Common Application is received.
schools.quote_en: Send us an email. Please note that we can waive this requirement only after
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: Common App 접수 후 이메일로 요청해야 해요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Email to request after Common App is received

schools.name: Barnard College
schools.toefl_recommended: 105+ (most competitive); 5.5+ expected for tests on/after Jan 20, 2026
schools.other_tests: SAT EBRW 700+ or ACT English/Reading 29+ satisfies requirement. TOEFL Essentials and MyBest not accepted; TOEFL iBT Home Edition and IELTS Indicator accepted
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어가 모국어 중 하나이거나, 중등 과정 전체를 영어가 주 수업 언어인 학교에서 다녔거나, 영어로 가르치는 IB 디플로마·A Level 과정 재학/이수, SAT EBRW 700+ 또는 ACT English·Reading 29+이면 면제돼요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Identify English as one of first languages; attended a school with English as primary language of instruction for the duration of secondary school; enrolled in/completed IB Diploma or A Level taught in English; SAT EBRW 700+ or ACT English or Reading 29+.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 지원 후 포털에서 이미 면제 처리되지 않았다면 admissions@barnard.edu로 이메일을 보내 면제를 요청해야 해요.
schools.waiver_process_en: After applying, email admissions@barnard.edu to have it waived if it has not already been waived in the Barnard Applicant Portal.
schools.quote_en: After you apply, please email admissions@barnard.edu to have your English Language Proficiency
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 포털에서 자동 면제 안 됐으면 이메일로 요청해야 해요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: If not already waived in portal, email to request

schools.name: Davidson College
schools.other_tests: SAT/ACT do not satisfy the requirement
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어가 공용어인 국가 출신, IB 디플로마의 English A 수강, 미국에서 고교 4년 수학 중 하나에 해당하면 면제돼요. 한국 국제학교의 영어 수업만으로는 목록에 없어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Waived for students who are from a country where English is an official language, are taking English A as part of the IB diploma, or spent four years of high school studying in the United States.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 자동으로 면제되지 않았다면 지원서 제출 후 admission@davidson.edu로 제목 'English Proficiency Waiver', 이름·생년월일·면제 사유를 적어 이메일을 보내야 해요.
schools.waiver_process_en: If not automatically waived, email admission@davidson.edu after applying with subject 'English Proficiency Waiver', including name, date of birth and reason.
schools.quote_en: please send an email to admission@davidson.edu with "English Proficiency Waiver"
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 자동 면제 안 되면 이메일로 요청해야 해요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: If not automatically waived, request by email

schools.name: Grinnell College
schools.toefl_recommended: 5.5+ typical for admits (107+ on previous scale)
schools.other_tests: All 3 TOEFL iBT formats and TOEFL Essentials accepted; MyBest accepted
schools.waiver_process_ko: 그리넬은 영어 시험 면제를 해주지 않아요. 모국어가 영어가 아니면 영어 수업 학교를 다녀도 공식 점수를 보내야 해요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Grinnell does not provide waivers; official scores required if native language is not English and/or high school instruction was not in English.
schools.quote_en: Grinnell does not provide waivers for TOEFL, IELTS, or Duolingo English Test scores.

schools.name: Hamilton College
schools.toefl_recommended: Listed 'minimum' 100 (before Jan 2026) / 5.0 (Jan 2026+, 5.5 recommended) — but page says no specific score requirement
schools.other_tests: TOEFL Home Edition accepted; no superscoring/MyBest
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어가 주 수업 언어인 중등학교에서 공부한 경우 영어 능력을 인정받을 수 있어요(면제 요청 필요).
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Students may demonstrate English proficiency through studies at a secondary school where English is the primary medium of instruction.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 지원자 포털 체크리스트에 있는 양식으로 면제를 요청해야 해요. 입학처는 필요 시 언제든 추가 증빙을 요구할 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Request the waiver via the form on the checklist in the applicant portal.
schools.quote_en: able to do so via a form found on the checklist in their applicant portal
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 포털 체크리스트 양식으로 요청해야 해요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Request via the applicant portal checklist form

schools.name: Middlebury College
schools.toefl_recommended: 5.5 (105 on iBT before Jan 21, 2026) — minimum recommended
schools.other_tests: Cambridge English C1 Advanced (recommended)
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어가 모국어이거나, 고교 수업을 (국가별 고교 기간에 따라 최근 3~4년) 전부 영어로 받았다면 제출하지 않아도 돼요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Not needed if native language is English, or high school classes were taught entirely in English (for the last three or four years, depending on duration of high school in your country).
schools.waiver_process_ko: 해당 조건이면 '제출할 필요 없다'고만 되어 있고, 별도 신청 절차 안내는 없어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: The page says you do not need to submit in these situations; no request process described.
schools.quote_en: You do not need to submit a language proficiency score in the following situations
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 고등학교 수업이 전부 영어여야 해요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: All high school classes taught entirely in English

schools.name: Smith College
schools.other_tests: PTE also accepted; TOEFL MyBest accepted (single-date scores also reviewed)
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어가 모국어이거나, 중등 과정 전체를 영어가 주 수업 언어인 학교에서 다녔거나, 미국 학교에서 2년 이상 영어로 수업받았거나, 영어로 가르치는 IB 디플로마·A level 과정 재학/이수 시 면제될 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: May be exempt if: English is first language; attended a school with English as primary language of instruction for the duration of secondary school; attended a U.S. school instructed in English for at least two years; enrolled in/completed IB Diploma or A level taught in English.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 면제 조건만 안내되어 있고 신청 방법은 나와 있지 않아요. 입학처에 확인하는 게 좋아요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Exemption criteria are listed but the process is not described.

schools.waiver_conditions_en: Required if English is not the primary language of instruction in the secondary school(s) attended for the last three years.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 수업 언어 기준만 안내되어 있고 별도 면제 신청 절차는 없어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Requirement is based on language of instruction for last three years; no waiver request process described.
schools.quote_en: If English is not the primary language of instruction in the secondary school(s)

schools.name: Wesleyan University
schools.other_tests: SAT EBRW 700; ACT Reading & English (or ELA) 29; Cambridge C1 Advanced/C2 Proficiency 190
schools.waiver_process_ko: 영어 시험은 선택이라 면제 신청이 필요 없어요. 다만 입학처가 필요하면 개별적으로 점수를 요청할 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: English proficiency testing is optional; the office may individually request results.
schools.quote_en: Submission of English proficiency testing is optional, but strongly recommended
schools.score_waiver_note_ko: ACT는 Reading과 English(또는 ELA) 29 이상

schools.other_tests: InitialView Interview accepted as a method; IBDP English A score 6 or 7 counts; TOEFL iBT Home Edition, ITP, Essentials not accepted

schools.waiver_process_ko: 지원서를 통해 방법 중 하나 이상을 보여주라고만 되어 있고, 별도 신청 절차는 안내돼 있지 않아요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Applicants choose one or more methods to show proficiency through their application; no separate request process described.
schools.quote_en: must demonstrate their English proficiency through their application

schools.name: Colgate University

schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어가 모국어이거나 영어가 주 수업 언어인 중등학교에 다니면 제출 대상이 아니에요. SAT 점수로는 면제되지 않아요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: Required for non-native English speakers who do not study at a secondary school where English is the primary language of instruction. Not waived based on SAT.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 대상 기준만 안내되어 있고 면제 신청 절차는 나와 있지 않아요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Only the criteria are stated; no waiver process described.
schools.quote_en: We do not waive the English proficiency requirement based on SAT results.

schools.name: University of Richmond
schools.other_tests: IELTS Indicator, TOEFL iBT Home Edition accepted
schools.waiver_conditions_ko: 영어 수업 중등학교 4년 이상 재학, ACT English 28+ 또는 SAT EBRW 660+, AP·IB·A-level 영어 과목 A/B 상당 성적(IB 5~7) 중 하나면 면제돼요.
schools.waiver_conditions_en: At least four years in an academically rigorous English-medium secondary school; ACT English 28 or SAT EBRW 660; A or B equivalent grade (IB 5–7) in AP, IB, or A-level English.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 따로 신청하지 않아도 입학처가 지원서 1차 검토 때 자격을 확인해 면제를 적용해요(몇 주 걸릴 수 있어요). 자가진단 도구로 미리 확인할 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Richmond verifies eligibility during initial application review and applies the waiver in the Spider Portal; may take weeks.
schools.quote_en: the waiver will be applied after an initial review of your application verifies eligibility
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 학업적으로 엄격한 학교여야 해요 (심사 중 자동 적용)
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Academically rigorous school; applied during review

schools.quote_en: If English is neither your native language nor the primary language of your secondary school

schools.waiver_conditions_en: Required if English is neither your first language nor your current language of instruction.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 대상 기준만 안내되어 있고 면제 절차는 나와 있지 않아요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Only the criteria are stated; no waiver process described.
schools.quote_en: If English is neither your first language nor your current language of instruction

schools.waiver_conditions_en: Required only for applicants whose first language is not English and who have never attended a secondary school where English is the primary language of instruction.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 대상 기준만 안내되어 있고 면제 절차는 나와 있지 않아요.

schools.name: Macalester College

schools.waiver_process_en: EPT submission is optional; recommended if first language is not English AND fewer than two years in an English-taught curriculum.

schools.name: Mount Holyoke College
schools.other_tests: Cambridge C1 Advanced / C2 Proficiency 185 minimum; PTE Academic over 68 (average)

schools.waiver_conditions_en: May consider waiving if: non-native speaker attending U.S. high school since 9th grade; non-native speaker enrolled since 9th grade in high school(s) outside the U.S. where English is the primary language of instruction (bilingual schools do not qualify); or other academic background demonstrating strong proficiency. Not waived based on SAT/ACT.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 지원자 포털에 링크된 English Language Proficiency Waiver Form을 지원 마감일까지 제출해야 해요. 학교 프로필이나 카운슬러 편지 첨부를 강하게 권장하고, 7~10 영업일 안에 답이 와요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Submit the waiver form linked in the applicant status portal by your round's deadline; school profile or counselor letter strongly encouraged; reply in 7–10 business days.
schools.quote_en: To request a waiver, submit the English Language Proficiency Waiver Form
schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 9학년부터 다녀야 하고, 포털 양식으로 신청해요 (승인 보장 안 돼요)
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Since 9th grade; submit portal form; approval not guaranteed

schools.name: Bryn Mawr College

schools.waiver_conditions_en: Approved waiver for native English speakers and/or those with full academic instruction in English (ALL classes in English except second languages, for the equivalent of grades 9–12). Bilingual programs, dual curriculum, international homeschooling do not qualify.

schools.waiver_process_en: After submitting the Common App, follow portal instructions to apply for a waiver; submitting proof anyway is strongly recommended.
schools.quote_en: you will find instructions on how to apply for a waiver

schools.waiver_conditions_en: Native/first language is English; full academic instruction in English throughout high school except world language classes (bilingual programs, dual curriculum, and international homeschooling not exempted); enrolled in/completed IB Diploma or A-level taught in English; attended a U.S. school with English instruction for at least two years.
schools.waiver_process_ko: 위 조건 충족 시 따로 요청해야 하는지는 명시되어 있지 않아요. 시험을 볼 수 없는 경우에는 지원 후 admission@coloradocollege.edu로 이름·생년월일을 적어 면제를 요청할 수 있어요.
schools.waiver_process_en: Page does not say whether condition-based waivers need a request. If exams are unavailable, request a waiver after applying by emailing admission@coloradocollege.edu with full name and date of birth.
schools.quote_en: you can request a waiver after you apply by emailing admission@coloradocollege.edu

schools.us_hs_extra_ko: 이메일로 양식을 받아 제출해야 해요
schools.us_hs_extra_en: Email to request the waiver form, then submit it

schools.us_hs_extra_en: Considered case by case after applying

schools.other_tests: PTE Academic accepted (no minimum stated)

schools.waiver_process_en: Complete the online exemption request form; requests are reviewed individually.
schools.quote_en: If you believe you qualify, please complete this exemption request form.

schools.waiver_process_en: Submit the online Pitzer English Language Test Waiver form with PDF evidence; an interview may be requested.
schools.quote_en: We consider waiver requests on a case-by-case basis. Not all waiver requests may be granted.

schools.name: Scripps College

schools.waiver_process_en: Email admissions with name, birth date, school name, and number of years in an English-language classroom.
schools.quote_en: To waive this requirement, please email
